sources.title: Joey Santoro et al., ERC-4626: Tokenized Vaults
Jeroen Offerijns et al., ERC-7540: Asynchronous ERC-4626 Tokenized Vaults

nodes.definition: Deposit and redeem previews bound received amounts from below; mint and withdraw previews bound required amounts from above, within the same transaction.
exclusions: ERC-7540 asynchronous flows override preview behavior.

nodes.definition: Previews include the applicable entry or exit fee; fee-free conversion estimates serve a different purpose.

nodes.summary: Vault previews use the wrong directional bound.
nodes.definition: Preview results violate the corresponding deposit, mint, withdraw, or redeem bound.
exclusions: Comparisons across changed state are insufficient evidence.

nodes.summary: Vault maximum methods overstate executable capacity.
nodes.definition: Maximum methods account for applicable limits and return zero when the corresponding operation is disabled.
exclusions: Preview methods deliberately ignore these limits.

nodes.definition: Overloaded deposit and mint claims require the controller or its approved operator.
exclusions: An authorized operator may differ from the receiver.

nodes.summary: Async claims confuse receiver with controller.
nodes.definition: Claim authorization must refer to the controller whose request is consumed.
exclusions: Distinct owner, controller, and receiver addresses are supported.

nodes.summary: An integration requires previews for an asynchronous flow.
nodes.definition: Preview functions for the asynchronous direction must revert; adapters must distinguish synchronous and asynchronous capabilities.
exclusions: The synchronous direction of a partially asynchronous vault retains its preview behavior.

nodes.summary: Pending vault requests lack a viable completion path.
nodes.definition: Locked assets or shares can remain pending. Review the documented fulfillment policy and any cancellation mechanism.
exclusions: Cancellation is optional; delay alone does not establish a defect.
